proofPoints.detail: parents_pinned is vacuously true for a path with no parent within boundary. Actual private callsites are only expected directories derived from base or manifest_path(base, validatedRelative), or leaves from that same manifest_path, and boundary is mandatory base.parent Programs. The mandatory Programs directory is opened/verified directly, so neither live callsite reaches the vacuous outside-boundary case. No public arbitrary path caller is introduced.

The full original comparison implementation before missing() is byte-identical. Revalidation still requires original directory/leaf IDs and actual bad bytes; semantic rollback still permits replacement IDs but requires same directory presence and exact actual original bad byte lengths/hash/missing leaves, with fresh native registration/marker/ACL/reparse/hardlink policy.

capture_with_directory_hook, its parameter and the hook invocation are all cfg(test). Production capture invokes capture_inner without a callback parameter. Hook runs after directory capture and exact_names and before any leaf traversal.

One newly named native test loops four deterministic cases: missing web + recreated leaf; missing root + recreated leaf; missing web + empty recreated directory; missing root + empty recreated directory. Every case requires Unsettled, rename failure while unexpected original directory is pinned, successful explicit checked Proof release and subsequent fixture restoration/recapture. These are four iterations of one test, not four independent reported test cases.

New traversal helper test accepts complete pinned Programs/base/web and rejects None web, None base and absent Programs map entry. This is one extra pure test, separate from the four-iteration native test.

No changes to broker.rs:64MiB nonempty normal image digest and private allow-empty preimage digest unchanged. Original6 Proof groups*64,8 process owner slots,72 leaves/closed directory set,30MiB checked aggregate,original120s lifecycle limit remain. Tail probes cover only fixed expected None directories (at most3 product descendants because Programs mandatory), one unexpected successful handle is added before immediate rejection, and uses existing owner rollover/cap/checked release. No new owner pool or native retry loop.

The new hook creates ordinary real directories, not junctions/reparse points. The static ancestor gate avoids opening/hash-reading all leaves under any originally absent ancestor regardless of what appears; final unexpected-open branch rejects both real/reparse directory objects without granting their trust. Arbitrary same-user mutation between successive observations or after pin return is not ruled out by these bounded checks.
